summary: KnowledgeGraphExplorer block (V4): search by name grouped by type, a type filter with counts, 'N of M shown', a history of the way you came, Network in the middle and a detail panel with the entity's relations and the ones linking to it, each a step to its neighbour. Expand neighbours asks onExpandRequest and the graph grows in place. A jump of more than one hop highlights the shortest path between the two. The history nav is named after the explorer and the panel is a named group, so two explorers on a page keep their landmarks apart.
